info.prompt: A cybernetic altar of chance: Gothic ribcage arches loom over a holographic craps table, their bone-white struts pulsing with neon cyan veins. Dice float in midair, their translucent facets refracting synaptic gold light onto a void-black surface where neural lattice patterns throb in time with an unseen heartbeat. Terminal text scrolls warnings in ancient glyphs.
